## Documentation Improvements

- Modern styling for guides, tutorials, and troubleshooting pages
- Consistent navigation header with active state highlighting
- GitHub-like styling with dark/light mode support
- Added guides/ and tutorials/ index pages

**Navigation:**
| Page | Link |
|------|------|
| Landing | / |
| Guides | /guides/ |
| Tutorials | /tutorials/ |
| API | /api/ |

## Documentation Restructure

**New Documentation Structure:**
- Hand-crafted landing page at https://krisgray.github.io/opencarl/
- API docs moved to /api/ (separate from guides/tutorials)
- Navigation tabs: Quick Start, Guides, Tutorials, API, GitHub

**Navigation:**
| Tab | Link |
|-----|------|
| Quick Start | #quick-start (anchor) |
| Guides | /guides/ |
| Tutorials | /tutorials/ |
| API | /api/ |
| GitHub | External link |

**Technical Changes:**
- typedoc.json outputs to docs/api/
- docs/index.html is now hand-crafted (committed to repo)
- Generated pages use correct relative asset paths
- Updated .gitignore to allow docs/index.html and docs/.nojekyll

## Documentation Fixes

- Added Troubleshooting page to website
- Updated README.md to link to troubleshooting webpage instead of markdown file
- Fixed docs build script to include all pages

## Documentation Improvements

- Tutorials now use `/opencarl` commands instead of manual file edits
- Added guides to website: Installation, Domain Guide, Commands Guide, Manifest Reference, Context Rules, Suggest Domain
- Updated README.md with links to all documentation guides
- Fixed duplicate content in INSTALL.md

**New webpages:**
- /install/ - Installation Guide
- /guides/opencarl-overview/
- /guides/domain-guide/
- /guides/commands-guide/
- /guides/manifest-reference/
- /guides/context-rules/
- /guides/suggest-domain/
